obernants.operator: parse_line returns None only on trimmed empty input. It scans trailing ^s tokens right-to-left before validating remaining anchors, Args, command, unused arguments and finally required anchor. Cursor sent supplies a default only without explicit anchors. Error stores untrimmed raw and supplied number, success stores trimmed raw.

obernants.operator: Tail tokens starting ^s parse as u16, so zero and repeated values are admitted, and integer parsing also permits accepted standard u16 spellings. Explicit anchors override cursor sent without equality checking. know's from is a separate stricter positive check.

obernants.operator: Failure order is token quotes, tail-anchor parse from rightmost, misplaced anchor, no command, Args scanning, command-specific field checks, leftover arguments, missing-anchor. Oracle uses lines with multiple defects to distinguish these phases; no generic lexical-versus-semantic priority is assumed.
